abstract: OBJECTIVES: To evaluate retrospective data concerning patients with adnexal masses that were managed surgically during pregnancy and their effect on fetal outcome. METHODS: Data were reviewed concerning pregnant women who required surgery at our hospital between 1980 and 1997 for an adnexal mass. RESULTS: In the past 19 years at our hospital a total of 69 Japanese women aged 28.5 +/- 3.4 years (including 2 women with twin pregnancies) were diagnosed with adnexal masses that required surgery. The masses (10.2 +/- 4.5 cm in the largest diameter) were removed at 13.9 +/- 3.7 weeks of gestation. The pathologic features of the 69 lesions were as follows: 33 mature cystic teratomas, 13 functional cysts, 8 mucinous cystadenomas, 6 endometriotic cysts, 4 paraovarian cysts, 3 serous cystadenomas, and 2 malignant neoplasms. Of the 60 patients for whom the outcome of pregnancy was available, 7 (12%) gave birth before 37 weeks of gestation, while 2 (3.3%) experienced spontaneous abortions. There were 3 perinatal deaths among the 60 infants. Two of these 3 infants died due to major anomalies. CONCLUSIONS: Although larger studies are required for confirmation, our results suggest that an adnexal mass might be associated with an adverse fetal outcome. Surgical intervention at < 24 weeks of gestation per se might not have been related to the adverse outcomes. We emphasize that surgical intervention during pregnancy can be avoided in patients who have ultrasonographically pathognomonic features of benign cystic teratomas, which are the most common neoplasms operated on during pregnancy.
abstract_ja: 目的：妊娠中に手術的治療を受けた付属器腫瘤の患者について、その胎児転帰への影響に関するデータを評価すること。方法：1980年から1997年までの間に、当院で妊娠中に手術を要する付属器腫瘤と診断された妊婦のデータを後方視的に検討した。結果：過去19年間に当院で手術を要する付属器腫瘤と診断された日本人女性は、双胎妊娠2例を含む69名であった（年齢28.5±3.4歳）。腫瘤（最大径10.2±4.5 cm）は妊娠13.9±3.7週で摘出された。69病変の病理所見は、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫33例、機能性嚢胞13例、粘液性嚢胞腺腫8例、子宮内膜症性嚢胞6例、傍卵巣嚢胞4例、漿液性嚢胞腺腫3例、悪性腫瘍2例であった。妊娠転帰が得られた60例のうち、7例（12%）が妊娠37週未満に出産し、2例（3.3%）が自然流産を経験した。60例の児のうち周産期死亡は3例で、そのうち2例は重篤な奇形により死亡した。結論：より大規模な研究による確認が必要であるが、本結果は付属器腫瘤が不良な胎児転帰と関連する可能性を示唆する。妊娠24週未満での手術そのものは、不良転帰とは関連していなかった可能性がある。超音波検査で良性嚢胞性奇形腫に特徴的な所見を有する患者では、妊娠中の手術を回避できることを強調する。良性嚢胞性奇形腫は、妊娠中に手術される最も一般的な腫瘍である。
